findings.description: Retrieved both brief.lists pages with curl (GET, no form, no credentials); bytes hashed with SHA-256; both retrieved after brief.created_at. No profile pages fetched (optional); decisions rest on the two list pages.

Enumeration: faculty list yields 33 person entries and the adjunct list yields 3, total 36, matching brief.people and scope.required_person_ids one-to-one. No omissions; no person on either page is missing from the brief.
The faculty page heading reads 'Jiang Liu' while the entry text reads 'Dr. Jian Liu' with email jliu@mst.edu; treated as the brief person, which is consistent with the title text.

Section headings: neither list page has section headings or category tags; the faculty page is a single flat list of primary department entries, and the adjunct page is a separate list of Adjunct Professors.

Kelvin Erickson: 'Curators' Distinguished Teaching Professor of Electrical and Computer Engineering' is a teaching-track rank under the convention, excluded as teaching. Borderline: an official statement of professorial (non-teaching) rank would change the outcome to regular/ece/current.

Mehdi Ferdowsi: named endowed professorship on the department's main faculty list, no rank word; decided regular under the department-roster convention. Borderline only in the sense that the rank word is absent; an official rank statement contradicting professorial rank would change it.
